root_cause.text: The `dataimage_scf0700c48ggu18` panel description structure in `drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c` is missing the `.connector_type` field, which is required by `devm_drm_panel_bridge_add()` to successfully register the panel bridge.
